```{=html}
<style>

<div class="dash-topbar"><a href="http://localhost:8501" target="_blank">AI要約を生成する（コックピット）↗</a></div>
<div id="dash-root"></div>

<script>
(async function () {
  const rootEl = document.getElementById("dash-root");
  const VAULT = "notes";  // Obsidian vault名（~/mysite/notes をvaultとして開いている前提）
  const CONTROLLED_TAGS = ["理論", "構造推定", "因果推論", "Health"];

  // 旧タグ → 統制タグの解釈（Zotero整理スクリプト実行前でも正しい構造で見せる）
  const THEORY_TAGS = new Set(["理論", "情報設計", "意思決定", "意思決定論", "統計的意思決定論",
    "スコア", "ナラティブ", "アルゴリズム", "アリゴリズム", "AI", "最適停止", "ベイズ",
    "Information", "Infromation", "Informaiton", "Inforamtion", "情報"]);
  const CAUSAL_TAGS = new Set(["因果推論", "Cousal", "Causal", "ABテスト"]);
  const HEALTH_TAGS = new Set(["Health", "health", "ヘルス"]);

  async function get(path) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(path, { cache: "no-store" });
      return res.ok ? await res.json() : null;
    } catch (e) { return null; }
  }

  const [data, shelf, aiListRaw] = await Promise.all([
    get("library.json"), get("shelf.json"), get("ai_list.json"),
  ]);
  const aiList = new Set(aiListRaw || []);

  if (!data) {
    rootEl.innerHTML =
      '<div class="dash-empty">まだデータがありません。デスクトップの「研究ダッシュボード.command」' +
      'から起動すると、Zotero（Econ.json）の内容が自動で読み込まれます。</div>';
    return;
  }

  // コレクション階層から「Theoryツリー所属のitemID」を求める
  const cols = data.collections || {};
  function rootName(key, seen) {
    seen = seen || new Set();
    while (key && !seen.has(key)) {
      seen.add(key);
      const c = cols[key];
      if (!c) return "";
      if (!c.parent) return c.name;
      key = c.parent;
    }
    return "";
  }
  const theoryIDs = new Set();
  for (const key of Object.keys(cols)) {
    if (rootName(key) === "Theory") {
      for (const iid of cols[key].items || []) theoryIDs.add(iid);
    }
  }

  const SHELF_MAP = { "未読": "to-read", "読中": "reading", "読書中": "reading", "読了": "done" };
  const SKIP_TYPES = new Set(["attachment", "note", "annotation"]);

  const items = (Array.isArray(data) ? data : data.items || [])
    .filter((it) => !SKIP_TYPES.has(it.itemType))
    .map((it) => {
      const tags = (it.tags || []).map((t) => (typeof t === "string" ? t : t.tag));
      const creators = it.creators
        ? it.creators.map((c) => c.lastName || c.name).filter(Boolean)
        : (it.author || []).map((a) => a.family || a.literal).filter(Boolean);
      const year =
        (it.date || "").match(/\d{4}/)?.[0] ||
        it.issued?.["date-parts"]?.[0]?.[0] || "";
      const ck = it.citationKey || it.id || "";
      const entry = shelf && shelf[ck];
      const status =
        (entry && SHELF_MAP[entry.status]) ||
        ["to-read", "reading", "done"].find((s) => tags.includes(s)) ||
        "to-read";
      // 統制タグの決定: 明示タグ → 旧タグ/コレクションからの推論 → 未分類
      let ctag = "未分類";
      if (tags.some((t) => HEALTH_TAGS.has(t))) ctag = "Health";
      else if (tags.includes("構造推定")) ctag = "構造推定";
      else if (tags.some((t) => CAUSAL_TAGS.has(t))) ctag = "因果推論";
      else if (tags.some((t) => THEORY_TAGS.has(t)) || theoryIDs.has(it.itemID)) ctag = "理論";
      return {
        title: it.title || "(no title)",
        authors: creators.join(", "),
        year: String(year),
        venue: it.publicationTitle || it["container-title"] || "",
        tags: tags.filter((t) => !SHELF_MAP[t] && !["to-read", "reading", "done"].includes(t)),
        ctag,
        status,
        star: !!(entry && entry.star),
        hasAI: aiList.has(ck),
        added: it.dateAdded || it.accessed || "",
        citekey: ck,
        url: it.url || it.URL || (it.DOI ? "https://doi.org/" + it.DOI : ""),
      };
    });

  items.sort((a, b) =>
    (b.star - a.star) || (b.added || "").localeCompare(a.added || ""));

  const STATUSES = [
    ["to-read", "未読"],
    ["reading", "読書中"],
    ["done", "読了"],
    ["all", "すべて"],
  ];
  let activeStatus = "to-read";
  let activeTag = null;
  let query = "";
  const openAI = new Set();     // AI要約を開いている citekey
  const aiCache = {};           // citekey → 要約JSON

  function count(s) {
    return s === "all" ? items.length : items.filter((i) => i.status === s).length;
  }

  function esc(t) {
    return String(t).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
  }

  function draftURI(i) {
    const file = "blog-drafts/" + i.ctag + "/" + (i.citekey || "無題");
    const body = [
      "---",
      'paper: "' + i.title.replace(/"/g, "'") + '"',
      "authors: " + i.authors,
      "year: " + i.year,
      "citekey: " + i.citekey,
      "tag: " + i.ctag,
      "status: draft",
      "---",
      "",
      "## 一言でいうと",
      "",
      "",
      "## 面白かったポイント",
      "",
      "",
      "## 自分の考え",
      "",
      "",
      "<!-- 書き終わったらClaudeに「書いた」と言えば、整形してブログに公開します -->",
      "",
    ].join("\n");
    return "obsidian://new?vault=" + encodeURIComponent(VAULT) +
      "&file=" + encodeURIComponent(file) +
      "&content=" + encodeURIComponent(body);
  }

  function aiPanelHTML(ck) {
    const s = aiCache[ck];
    if (s === undefined) return '<div class="dash-ai">読み込み中…</div>';
    if (!s) return '<div class="dash-ai">要約を読み込めませんでした。</div>';
    const lead = s.for_public ? '<div class="lead">' + esc(s.for_public) + "</div>" : "";
    const body = (s.narrative || s.faithful?.abstract_ja || "")
      .split(/\n+/).filter(Boolean)
      .map((p) => "<p>" + esc(p).replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, "<strong>$1</strong>") + "</p>")
      .join("");
    return '<div class="dash-ai">' + lead + body + "</div>";
  }

  function render() {
    const visible = items.filter((i) => {
      const okStatus = activeStatus === "all" || i.status === activeStatus;
      const okTag = !activeTag || i.ctag === activeTag;
      const q = query.toLowerCase();
      const okQuery =
        !q || (i.title + " " + i.authors + " " + i.venue).toLowerCase().includes(q);
      return okStatus && okTag && okQuery;
    });

    const stats = STATUSES.map(
      ([key, label]) =>
        '<div class="dash-stat' + (key === activeStatus ? " active" : "") +
        '" data-status="' + key + '">' +
        '<div class="dash-stat-num">' + count(key) + "</div>" +
        '<div class="dash-stat-label">' + label + "</div></div>"
    ).join("");

    const tagCounts = {};
    for (const i of items) tagCounts[i.ctag] = (tagCounts[i.ctag] || 0) + 1;
    const chips = [null, ...CONTROLLED_TAGS, "未分類"]
      .filter((t) => t === null || tagCounts[t])
      .map((t) =>
        '<span class="dash-tagchip' + (t === activeTag ? " active" : "") +
        '" data-tag="' + (t || "") + '">' +
        (t ? t + " " + tagCounts[t] : "すべて") + "</span>"
      ).join("");

    const list = visible.length
      ? visible.map((i) => {
          const meta = [i.authors, i.year, i.venue].filter(Boolean).join(" ・ ");
          const zoteroLink = i.citekey
            ? '<a href="zotero://select/items/@' + esc(i.citekey) + '">Zotero</a>'
            : "";
          const urlLink = i.url ? '<a href="' + esc(i.url) + '" target="_blank">原文</a>' : "";
          const draftLink = '<a class="draft" href="' + draftURI(i) + '">✍ 下書き</a>';
          const statusLabel = { "to-read": "未読", reading: "読書中", done: "読了" }[i.status];
          const aiBtn = i.hasAI
            ? '<button class="ai-toggle' + (openAI.has(i.citekey) ? " open" : "") +
              '" data-ck="' + esc(i.citekey) + '">AI要約 ' +
              (openAI.has(i.citekey) ? "▴" : "▾") + "</button>"
            : "";
          const tags =
            '<span class="dash-tag st-' + i.status + '">' + statusLabel + "</span>" +
            aiBtn +
            i.tags.slice(0, 4).map((t) => '<span class="dash-tag">' + esc(t) + "</span>").join("");
          const aiPanel = openAI.has(i.citekey) ? aiPanelHTML(i.citekey) : "";
          return (
            '<div class="dash-item">' +
            '<div class="dash-item-title">' +
            (i.star ? '<span class="dash-star">★</span>' : "") +
            (i.url ? '<a href="' + esc(i.url) + '" target="_blank">' + esc(i.title) + "</a>" : esc(i.title)) +
            "</div>" +
            '<div class="dash-item-meta">' + esc(meta) + "</div>" +
            '<div class="dash-item-tags">' + tags +
            '<span class="dash-links">' + zoteroLink + urlLink + draftLink + "</span></div>" +
            aiPanel + "</div>"
          );
        }).join("")
      : '<div class="dash-empty">該当する論文はありません。</div>';

    rootEl.innerHTML =
      '<div class="dash-stats">' + stats + "</div>" +
      '<div class="dash-tagrow">' + chips + "</div>" +
      '<input class="dash-search" type="search" placeholder="タイトル・著者・掲載誌で検索" value="' +
      esc(query) + '">' + list;

    rootEl.querySelectorAll(".dash-stat").forEach((el) =>
      el.addEventListener("click", () => {
        activeStatus = el.dataset.status;
        render();
      })
    );
    rootEl.querySelectorAll(".dash-tagchip").forEach((el) =>
      el.addEventListener("click", () => {
        activeTag = el.dataset.tag || null;
        render();
      })
    );
    rootEl.querySelectorAll("button.ai-toggle").forEach((el) =>
      el.addEventListener("click", async () => {
        const ck = el.dataset.ck;
        if (openAI.has(ck)) { openAI.delete(ck); render(); return; }
        openAI.add(ck);
        render();
        if (aiCache[ck] === undefined) {
          aiCache[ck] = await get("ai/" + ck + ".json");
          render();
        }
      })
    );
    const search = rootEl.querySelector(".dash-search");
    search.addEventListener("input", (e) => {
      query = e.target.value;
      render();
    });
  }

  render();
})();
</script>
```
